Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.EscalarEnSelect
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.EscalarEnSelect AS BEGIN SELECT m.Id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Hijos h WHERE h.Estado = 0) AS N FROM dbo.Madre m; END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.EscalarEnSelectCorrelacionada
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.EscalarEnSelectCorrelacionada AS BEGIN SELECT m.Id, (SELECT MAX(h.Fecha) FROM dbo.Hijos h WHERE h.MadreId = m.Id) AS UltimaFecha FROM dbo.Madre m; END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.IfExists
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.IfExists AS BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Listas WHERE Nombre = 'x') SELECT 1; END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.IfNotExists
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.IfNotExists AS BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Listas WHERE Codigo = 'y') INSERT INTO dbo.Listas (Nombre) VALUES ('nueva'); END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.InSelect
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.InSelect AS BEGIN SELECT Id FROM dbo.Madre WHERE Id IN (SELECT PadreId FROM dbo.Hijos); END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.InSelectConWhereDentro
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.InSelectConWhereDentro AS BEGIN SELECT Id FROM dbo.Madre WHERE Id IN (SELECT PadreId FROM dbo.Hijos WHERE Estado = 1); END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.OrderByCol
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.OrderByCol AS BEGIN SELECT Id FROM dbo.Madre ORDER BY Creado; END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.OrderByDosColumnasConAlias
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.OrderByDosColumnasConAlias AS BEGIN SELECT m.Id AS Ident FROM dbo.Madre m ORDER BY m.Creado, m.Nombre DESC; END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.OutputIns
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.OutputIns AS BEGIN INSERT INTO dbo.Madre (Id) OUTPUT inserted.Codigo VALUES (1); END

Name: BlindPatternsDb::dbo.OutputDel
Sql: CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.OutputDel AS BEGIN DELETE FROM dbo.Madre OUTPUT deleted.Nombre WHERE Id = 1; END
